title: World Cup 2026: Know the Tournament
description: Biggest World Cup ever. Three nations, 48 teams. Are you up to speed?

questions.q: How many teams compete at the 2026 World Cup?
questions.explain: Expanded from 32 to 48 teams for the first time.

questions.q: Which three countries are co-hosting the 2026 World Cup?
questions.explain: The first World Cup hosted by three nations.

questions.q: How many total matches will be played at the 2026 World Cup?
How are the 48 teams divided in the group stage?
Which stadium hosts the 2026 World Cup final?
questions.explain: The final is at MetLife Stadium near New York.

questions.q: How many host cities span the 2026 tournament across the three nations?
questions.explain: 16 host cities across the USA, Canada and Mexico.

questions.q: Which country becomes the first to host the World Cup three times?
questions.explain: Mexico hosted in 1970, 1986 and now co-hosts 2026.

questions.q: How many teams advance from the group stage to the knockout rounds?
questions.explain: Top 2 of each group plus 8 best third-placed teams = 32.

questions.q: How many matches does each team play in the 2026 group stage?
questions.explain: Each team plays 3 group-stage matches. The 48 teams are split into 12 groups of four, with each team facing the other three in their group before the knockout rounds.

questions.q: Canada is a 2026 co-host. How many World Cups had they previously qualified for as a participant?
questions.explain: Canada qualified for just one World Cup before 2026 — the 1986 tournament in Mexico, where they went out in the group stage without scoring a single goal.
